text: There is a sense of anticipation as I enter this modern, brightly lit space. The glass walls and countdown timer suggest an environment where time and innovation matter. I feel both curious and slightly tense, wondering what purpose this room serves and how I might fit into it. Standing by the display, the bold letters 'R+D' and the talk of rapid evolution spark thoughts about the ceaseless march of progress. I am keenly aware of the energy of research and discovery; it feels exciting and a little overwhelming. I question how I, too, might contribute to or be shaped by these advancements.
